title: vs/v1/dev/{id}/cmd/ota: update the firmware over the air (spec 5.5)

url.description: Where the hornet downloads the image (the hive, plain HTTP inside the IoT segment)

md5.description: Checked before the image is installed; arrives over the authenticated MQTT channel, so it also binds the content to the hive

size.description: Image size in bytes; the hornet refuses an image that does not fit its flash

version.description: Version the image reports as fw after the update

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (hex) of the SHA-512 digest of the image, made with the developer's private key at build time. A hornet that carries the matching public key refuses an update without it, or with one that does not match, before the image is marked for the bootloader (docs/ota.md)
